items: ½ cup Greek yogurt (alternatively sour cream)
¼ cup applesauce (alternatively oil or mashed banana)

steps.title: Preheat and grease
steps.body: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a standard 12-cup muffin tin with spray.

steps.title: Combine the dry ingredients
steps.body: Combine the dry ingredients in a large bowl: **½ cup whole wheat flour**, **⅔ cup all-purpose flour**, **⅓ cup sugar**, **⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder**, **1 tsp baking soda**, **¼ tsp cinnamon**, **¼ tsp salt** and **½ cup chocolate chips**.

steps.title: Beat the wet ingredients
steps.body: In a medium bowl, beat together the wet ingredients: **2 large eggs**, **½ cup Greek yogurt** (alternatively sour cream), **½ cup milk**, **¼ cup applesauce** (alternatively oil or mashed banana) and **1 tsp vanilla extract**.

steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.body: Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and stir in the wet mixture until just moistened (don’t over-mix).

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Put batter in the tin and bake for 12–15 minutes (until a toothpick comes out clean).

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Let cool on a wire rack, then enjoy.
